title: Model a bonded summon's pocket-dimension presence and action dismissal/recall (Find Familiar, Find Steed)
description:
Split from eshyra-71u1 (2026-10-07). The engine does not model a bonded summon's pocket-dimension presence, and it executes no action-triggered presence transition. spell:find-familiar declares temporary-pocket-dismissal (action-temporary-dismissal: present -> pocket-dimension), pocket-recall (action-recall: pocket -> present, place-in-unoccupied-space within 30 ft), permanent-dismissal-from-present-or-pocket (link none), and reform-pocketed-familiar (cast-again select-new-form, no presence change). spell:find-steed declares action-dismissal (present -> absent, link active) and release-bond (action-release from present or absent -> link none). All of these are narrated only today. A pocketed familiar is indistinguishable from a present one: it is status alive and keeps its combat projection.

Design questions to settle before implementation:
1. Representation. A new ActorStatus/CombatantLifeStatus 'pocketed' (needs a migration for the status CHECKs; must keep HP, conditions, exhaustion; is not terminal, unlike absent), or 'absent' plus a presence marker? Absent is terminal for combatant rows and implies 0 HP for vanish-bonded creatures, which argues for a distinct status.
2. Mid-combat. Dismissal and recall each cost an action, so both can happen in combat. Dismissal takes the combatant out of play (does concentration break? the familiar can't concentrate anyway; check F3 owner-removed). Recall must bring the same creature back into the same combat instance at the same HP: is initiative re-rolled, or kept? There is a remanifest path in startEncounterInTxn, but absent is terminal there.
3. A Find Steed action dismissal is present -> absent with the link active. A later recast restores it at maximum HP (restore-same-steed). This reuses the s02z restore path, but through a new entry point that is not 0 HP.
4. Release and permanent dismissal set link none. Check whether end_effect / remove_effect_target already cover this, or whether a record-driven transition tool is wanted. ambiguity:find-familiar-permanent-dismissal-after-zero-hp stays gated.
5. One record-driven tool (e.g. transition_bonded_summon { effectId, trigger }) that executes action-* transitions from the spell record, rather than per-spell tools.
Docs: docs/active-effect-lifecycle.md section 6 and sections 8-9.
design:
DESIGN DECISIONS (Claude Captain, 2026-10-08). Answers the five questions in the description.

SOURCE (spell:find-familiar, spell:find-steed records.json; SRD 5.1 p. 143 / p. 144):
- Familiar: "As an action, you can temporarily dismiss your familiar. It disappears into a pocket dimension where it awaits your summons. Alternatively, you can dismiss it forever. As an action while it is temporarily dismissed, you can cause it to reappear in any unoccupied space within 30 feet of you."
- Steed: "You can also dismiss your steed at any time as an action, causing it to disappear. In either case, casting this spell again summons the same steed, restored to its hit point maximum." / "As an action, you can release the steed from its bond at any time, causing it to disappear."
The record transitions are authority: temporary-pocket-dismissal, pocket-recall (operation place-in-unoccupied-space withinFeet 30), permanent-dismissal-from-present-or-pocket, permanent-dismissal-from-zero-hp-absence (availability source-ambiguity -> stays gated), reform-pocketed-familiar (cast-again select-new-form, no presence change); steed action-dismissal, release-bond.

Q1 REPRESENTATION. New ActorStatus 'pocketed' on the CAMPAIGN ACTOR only (migration: campaign_actor status CHECK). NOT a CombatantStatus. A pocketed actor is out of play but not terminal and keeps hp_current, hp_max, rules_ref, conditions (incl. exhaustion) and its combat lifecycle (zero_hp_rule vanish-bonded). Reasons: absent is terminal for a combatant row (I9) and for vanish-bonded implies a max-HP/new-form restore; a CombatantStatus would need every absent guard in the combat engine duplicated (a missed guard = a pocketed creature taking damage). Only a vanish-bonded actor held by an active actor link of an active, spell-sourced summoning effect whose record has a pocket-dimension presence can be pocketed.

Q2 MID-COMBAT. Initiative and turn order are model-narrated (actionEconomy.ts), so no initiative slot exists to keep or re-roll; SRD "In combat, it rolls its own initiative" stays narrated.
- Dismissal while the creature has a live combatant in the active instance: the combatant leaves play through the existing remove seam (removeCombatantFromPlay: row becomes absent, concentration break as for any leaving-play), its actor link(s) are rebound to the campaign actor immediately (same rebind the closure does), and the campaign actor ends with the right status (pocketed for the familiar's temporary dismissal, keeping the HP/conditions it had at dismissal; absent for steed dismissal / release / permanent dismissal). The stale absent row must never later overwrite the actor (closure sync / syncCombatantActor must not write an absent row onto a pocketed actor).
- Recall while a combat instance is active: the actor returns alive with everything it had, and is projected into the ACTIVE instance as a NEW combatant row (absent never returns on the same row). Factor the campaign-actor projection block of startEncounterInTxn into one internal seam used by both start_encounter and the recall, so the projection rules cannot drift. Row id: `${instance}-${slug(actorId)}` when free, else the next `-2`, `-3`... currentActorProjectionId must break ties within one instance by newest row. side/faction default to the actor's most recent row in that instance; with no such row the tool requires side. placement optional (the record's place-in-unoccupied-space within 30 ft is narrated and reported).
- Recall with no active combat: actor pocketed -> alive, nothing else changes.

Q3 STEED ACTION DISMISSAL. present -> absent with the link active: actor absent (via the existing remove seams), link and effect untouched, so start_encounter refuses it and recast_bonded_summon's restore-same-steed restores it at maximum HP (existing s02z path, no new entry point needed).

Q4 RELEASE / PERMANENT DISMISSAL (link -> none, presence -> absent). Do NOT route through end_effect: Find Familiar/Steed derive no spell-ended cleanup, so a stored 'release' policy would leave the creature alive and unbonded, contradicting "causing it to disappear". The transition takes the creature out of play (absent, from present or pocketed; a steed already absent stays absent), closes its actor link (status removed), and ends the effect with reason 'dismissed' when no active actor link remains. Afterwards the actor is an unbonded absent actor: start_encounter admits it only as a new manifestation (existing rule). permanent-dismissal-from-zero-hp-absence stays refused, naming ambiguity:find-familiar-permanent-dismissal-after-zero-hp.
Also: any OTHER path that ends a bond while the actor is pocketed (end_effect with a release policy, closure) must take it out of play (absent), never leave an unbonded pocketed actor; report it as removed.

Q5 ONE RECORD-DRIVEN TOOL. transition_bonded_summon { effectId, spellRef, trigger, side?, faction?, placement? }, trigger in action-temporary-dismissal | action-recall | action-permanent-dismissal | action-dismissal | action-release. It selects the record transition by trigger AND current presence (alive -> present, pocketed -> pocket-dimension, absent -> absent; any other status refused naming it) with link active, never by spell name; refuses a transition with an availability gate (naming the ambiguity id) and any change combination the engine does not execute. It spends no action: the description tells the model to spend the caster's action with spend_turn_resource in combat (same split as recast_bonded_summon and spell slots). Records a new active_effect_event kind (e.g. 'presence-transition') with spellRef, transitionId, trigger, actor, from, to, and the combatant ids left/entered.
recast_bonded_summon: pocketed maps to pocket-dimension, so reform-pocketed-familiar executes (stays pocketed, new form, new form's HP per the 71u1 rule); remove the "pocket presence is not modelled" text.

SPLIT OUT: a generic model-facing way to admit creatures to an active combat instance (mid-combat summons such as Conjure Animals cast in round 3 currently cannot get combatants: start_encounter only opens a new instance and only one may be active). This bead adds only the internal seam the recall needs.
